007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import java.util.Arrays;
009import java.util.HashMap;
010import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
011import java.util.List;

013import org.wpilib.tunable.util.PathUtil;
014
015/** A mock tunable backend for testing. */
016public class MockTunableBackend implements TunableBackend {
017  private final Map<String, Object> m_entries = new HashMap<>();
018
019  private record Action(String path, TunableBase tunable, Runnable update) {}
020
021  private final List<Action> m_actions = new ArrayList<>();
022
023  /** Constructs a mock tunable backend. */
024  public MockTunableBackend() {}
025
026  private void addAction(Action action) {
027    synchronized (m_actions) {
028      m_actions.add(action);
029    }
030  }
031
032  private List<Action> takeActions() {
033    synchronized (m_actions) {
034      List<Action> actions = new ArrayList<>(m_actions);
035      m_actions.clear();
036      return actions;
037    }
038  }
039
040  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
041  private boolean isCurrentAction(Action action) {
042    synchronized (m_entries) {
043      return m_entries.get(action.path) == action.tunable;
044    }
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Gets a published tunable.
049   *
050   * @param path normalized path
051   * @return tunable
052   */
053  public TunableBase getTunable(String path) {
054    path = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
055    synchronized (m_entries) {
056      var rawTunable = m_entries.get(path);
057      return switch (rawTunable) {
058        case null -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such tunable: " + path);
059        case TunableBase tunable -> tunable;
060        default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tunable at " + path + " is not a tunable");
061      };
062    }
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  public void close() {
067    synchronized (m_entries) {
068      m_entries.clear();
069    }
070  }
071
072  private static void notifyOnTune(TunableBase tunable) {
073    TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(tunable);
074    var config = tunable.getConfig();
075    if (config != null) {
076      var onTune = config.getOnTune();
077      if (onTune != null) {
078        TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(onTune);
079      }
080    }
081  }
082
083  private static boolean isMutable(TunableBase tunable) {
084    var config = tunable.getConfig();
085    return config == null || config.isMutable();
086  }
087
088  private static boolean hasTypeClass(Tunable<?> tunable, Class<?> cls) {
089    Class<?> tunableTypeClass = tunable.getTypeClass();
090    return tunableTypeClass != null && cls.isAssignableFrom(tunableTypeClass);
091  }

188  /**
189   * Gets the value of a tunable.
190   *
191   * @param <T> value type
192   * @param path normalized path
193   * @param cls expected value class, superclass, or interface
194   * @return value
195   */
196  public <T> T getValue(String path, Class<T> cls) {
197    path = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
198    synchronized (m_entries) {
199      var rawTunable = m_entries.get(path);
200      return switch (rawTunable) {
201        case null -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such tunable: " + path);
202        case Tunable<?> tunable when hasTypeClass(tunable, cls) -> cls.cast(tunable.get());
203        default ->
204            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
205                "Tunable at " + path + " is not a Tunable<" + cls.getSimpleName() + ">");
206      };
207    }
208  }

210  /**
211   * Sets the value of a tunable.
212   *
213   * @param path normalized path
214   * @param value value
215   */
216  public void setBoolean(String path, boolean value) {
217    path = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
218    synchronized (m_entries) {
219      var rawTunable = m_entries.get(path);
220      switch (rawTunable) {
221        case null -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such tunable: " + path);
222        case TunableBoolean tunable ->
223            addAction(
224                new Action(
225                    path,
226                    tunable,
227                    () -> {
228                      if (isMutable(tunable)) {
229                        tunable.set(value);
230                        notifyOnTune(tunable);
231                      }
232                    }));
233        default ->
234            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tunable at " + path + " is not a TunableBoolean");
235      }
236    }
237  }

355  /**
356   * Sets the value of a tunable.
357   *
358   * @param <T> value type
359   * @param path normalized path
360   * @param value value
361   */
362  public <T> void setValue(String path, T value) {
363    path = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
364    synchronized (m_entries) {
365      var rawTunable = m_entries.get(path);
366      switch (rawTunable) {
367        case null -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such tunable: " + path);
368        case Tunable<?> tunable when tunable.getTypeClass() == value.getClass() -> {
369          @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
370          Tunable<T> typedTunable = (Tunable<T>) tunable;
371          addAction(
372              new Action(
373                  path,
374                  typedTunable,
375                  () -> {
376                    if (isMutable(typedTunable)) {
377                      typedTunable.set(value);
378                      notifyOnTune(typedTunable);
379                    }
380                  }));
381        }
382        default ->
383            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
384                "Tunable at "
385                    + path
386                    + " is not a Tunable<"
387                    + value.getClass().getSimpleName()
388                    + ">");
389      }
390    }
391  }

599  @Override
600  public boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
601    path = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
602    synchronized (m_entries) {
603      if (m_entries.containsKey(path)) {
604        TunableRegistry.reportWarning("Tunable already exists: " + path);
605        return false;
606      }
607      m_entries.put(path, tunable);
608    }
609    return true;
610  }
611
612  @Override
613  public boolean publishComplex(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
614    path = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
615    synchronized (m_entries) {
616      if (m_entries.containsKey(path)) {
617        TunableRegistry.reportWarning("Tunable already exists: " + path);
618        return false;
619      }
620      m_entries.put(path, tunable);
621    }
622
623    TunableRegistry.publishComplexChildren(path, tunable);
624    return true;
625  }
626
627  @Override
628  public void remove(String path) {
629    String normalizedPath = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
630    synchronized (m_entries) {
631      m_entries.remove(normalizedPath);
632    }
633    synchronized (m_actions) {
634      m_actions.removeIf(action -> action.path.equals(normalizedPath));
635    }
636  }
637
638  @Override
639  public List<PublishedTunable> removePrefix(String prefix) {
640    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizePrefix(prefix);
641    List<PublishedTunable> removed = new ArrayList<>();
642    synchronized (m_entries) {
643      var iterator = m_entries.entrySet().iterator();
644      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
645        var entry = iterator.next();
646        if (!PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(entry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
647          continue;
648        }
649        switch (entry.getValue()) {
650          case ComplexTunable tunable ->
651              removed.add(new PublishedTunable(entry.getKey(), null, tunable));
652          case TunableBase tunable ->
653              removed.add(new PublishedTunable(entry.getKey(), tunable, null));
654          default -> TunableRegistry.reportWarning("Unexpected tunable entry type");
655        }
656        iterator.remove();
657      }
658    }
659    synchronized (m_actions) {
660      m_actions.removeIf(action -> PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(action.path, normalizedPrefix));
661    }
662    return removed;
663  }
664
665  @Override
666  public void update() {
667    List<Action> actions = takeActions();
668    for (Action action : actions) {
669      if (isCurrentAction(action)) {
670        action.update().run();
671      }
672    }
673
674    List<ComplexTunable> complexTunables = new ArrayList<>();
675    synchronized (m_entries) {
676      IdentityHashMap<ComplexTunable, Boolean> seenComplexTunables = new IdentityHashMap<>();
677      for (Object entry : m_entries.values()) {
678        if (entry instanceof ComplexTunable tunable
679            && seenComplexTunables.put(tunable, Boolean.TRUE) == null) {
680          complexTunables.add(tunable);
681        }
682      }
683    }
684    for (ComplexTunable tunable : complexTunables) {
685      TunableRegistry.updateComplexIfNeeded(tunable);
686    }
687  }
